toolNotes.n8n: Best choice: connects directly to Vector stores or LLMs while updating internal CRMs with zero SaaS markups.
toolNotes.make: Very clean JSON webhook processing; rate limits can trigger if chat spikes.
toolNotes.zapier: Too slow for conversational chat latency requirements.
